title: Summary rail & activity (unit)
description: The read-only right column of a record sheet: the **Summary card** shows what the form computes (totals, counts, the headline figure), the **Activity card** shows the record's history. It answers "what has this record become?" and "what happened to it, when, by whom?". — spec: docs/fpds/units/summary-rail.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.
